comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
It doesn’t give you anything. There’s already a dev balaclava in the game, you get one when you make a dev profile. You can also give one to yourself via commando.

This mod makes that balaclava actually make you invincible, because it only stops bullets in vanilla.

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
This mod was made during 3.10 and primarily because I was tired of dying to grenades while testing my mods during development.

3.11 is perfectly playable in my experience so far.

This mod isn’t meant for normal playthroughs, although nothing stops you from using it.

Perhaps you would be interested in Dad Gamer Mode, as that is meant to alleviate the pain of death in a better manner.

comments.author: SteeleNThunder
comments.body_html:
Not sure if Dad Gamer Mode would even work for this update. Im currently playing on 3.11.1 and its so terrible. The bots dont aim anywhere except for your face and they land the first bullet fired out of their gun right between your eyes. It really does feel like Im playing against cheaters this update. Ive had 2 maybe 3 gunfights out of my 41 levels of progression where I actually get shot in my limbs and then have to heal them up.

Just recently downloaded the headgear restrictions mod so I could wear an Altyn and an armored face shield at the same time and it is still awful. One tapped to the face every raid.

I was under the impression that you put this mod up because the one taps are way out of pocket this wipe.
Really appreciate the response though man. Ill be sticking to normal PVE until they fix this jank.

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
3.11 Dad Gamer Mode:

There’s nothing for SPT to fix, this is how BSG wrote the AI in the client version SPT uses. There are mods to help with that, but it’s not an SPT issue.

You may also consider using Drakia’s new mod to remove boss brains from PMCs.

comments.author: SteeleNThunder
comments.body_html:
See now that’s got me really confused because SPT and PVE play nothing alike. I just downloaded ‘Remove Boss Brains’ either yesterday or the day before that and it seems to be no different then my raids previously. It could be that my mods are not in the right order but I just highly doubt that is the case. I also dont think its only me that is having this problem. If you look at the comment section of Drakia’s new mod ‘Remove Boss Brains’ there are plenty of people complaining about the same issue. But again, it could be my mod order or something else that Im just not recognizing. This is the only update in which I didnt download the Load Order Editor because besides getting consistently face shot all my other mods and plugins seem to be running perfectly. (As far as I can tell)

**Just got out of a factory raid and a PMC shot me 5 times directly in the face shield of my Altyn before I finally died. He hit me NOWHERE else.**

Again, I appreciate you providing me with these links my friend!
